{{nihongo|'''Co-Enshrinement of Hirawoka Shrine'''|（合祀）牧岡神社（足羽神社境内）}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Echizen Province]].
